description: Roadmap completion tracking against ROADMAP.md. Not a game compatibility percentage. Category and overall values are derived from task data by src/progress.rs and are never stored here.

tasks.name: AArch64 test interpreter
tasks.description: Real AArch64 subset interpreter used by the guest demo and kernel tests.
tasks.notes: Test harness only, not the Xbox ISA. Excluded from roadmap credit (ADR 0001).

tasks.name: PowerPC legacy decoder
tasks.description: Big-endian PowerPC subset from the Xbox 360 work.
tasks.notes: Xbox 360 legacy, outside the ADR 0001 target. Excluded from roadmap credit.

tasks.name: x86-64 decoder and JIT subset
tasks.description: x86-64 subset interpreter for synthetic PE32+ guests plus WASM JIT research subset.
tasks.notes: Bounded x86-64 subset executes synthetic guests; not a complete x86-64 emulator and does not run retail Xbox Series X|S titles.

tasks.name: Win64 to host ABI bridge
tasks.description: Calling-convention seam, stack bounds, shadow space, and stack-argument ABI for x86-64 guest execution (ADR 0001 phase 24E).
tasks.notes: Configurable Microsoft x64 ABI (RCX/RDX/R8/R9 + stack args up to 16, 32-byte shadow space, 16-byte pre-call alignment, RAX return, stack overflow/underflow checks); XMM/float args and native JIT thunks not implemented.

tasks.name: HLE API registry
tasks.description: Metadata registry of imported modules and functions with implementation states.
tasks.notes: Metadata only; no function is implemented through the registry.

tasks.name: Executable import analyzer
tasks.description: Read-only PE32+ import analysis compared against the HLE registry.
tasks.notes: Analysis only; executables are never run.

tasks.name: Gen9 HLE dispatch runtime
tasks.description: Central dispatch runtime bound to the single HLE registry: module/symbol lookup, implemented vs placeholder separation, structured unsupported/unknown/failed results.
tasks.evidence: src/core/hle/runtime.rs unit tests; src/core/pipeline/mod.rs and tests/guest_pipeline_tests.rs
tasks.notes: Wired to X64Cpu via GuestSession for synthetic PE32+ guests (XMemAlloc/XMemFree); no retail title execution and no Microsoft GDK dependency.

tasks.name: xmem guest memory foundation
tasks.description: Guest-address-space heap with allocation tracking, bounds/alignment validation, protection metadata and XMemAlloc/XMemFree dispatch shims.
tasks.evidence: src/core/hle/xmem.rs unit tests (9); src/core/hle/runtime.rs xmem_alloc/xmem_free shims
tasks.notes: XMem attribute bitfields are recorded but not decoded (GDK reference is access-restricted); XMemVirtualAlloc and the physical-page/transfer/statistics imports stay Unknown.

tasks.name: Simulated syscall layer
tasks.description: Simulated kernel syscalls for the test guest.
tasks.notes: Simulated, not Xbox kernel ABI.

tasks.name: XAM service layer
tasks.description: XAM service imports for retail titles.
tasks.notes: No verified Series X|S XAM ABI; existing ordinals come from the Xbox 360 table and are not used as evidence.

tasks.name: Page table model
tasks.description: Page table entry model for guest memory.
tasks.notes: Model only; no hardware MMU.

tasks.name: Host presentation via wgpu
tasks.description: Host-side presentation of frames through wgpu.
tasks.notes: Presents frames; not a guest GPU translation.

tasks.name: Guest framebuffer blit
tasks.description: Direct blit of the guest framebuffer to the host surface.
tasks.notes: Only the test guest writes frames.

tasks.name: Shader translation
tasks.description: DXIL parsing and shader translation.
tasks.notes: No guest draw-call translation; no Xbox shader compatibility claimed.

tasks.name: Swapchain state
tasks.description: Swapchain state model.
tasks.notes: Model; not verified against Xbox behaviour.

tasks.name: Flat guest memory
tasks.description: Flat guest address space with region classification.
tasks.notes: No paging or fault handling.

tasks.name: PE32+ parser and mapping
tasks.description: PE32+ validation, section mapping, relocations, and IAT import resolution.
tasks.notes: Verified on synthetic PE32+ fixtures; delay-load imports, TLS callbacks, and encrypted retail packages are not supported.

tasks.name: XEX2 fixture loader
tasks.description: Loader for the bundled XEX2 test fixture layout.
tasks.notes: Only the contiguous fixture layout. Xbox 360 format; no retail XEX support.

tasks.name: Disc image scanning
tasks.description: ISO and optical mount scanning.
tasks.notes: Listing only; no decryption.

tasks.name: Audio abstraction
tasks.description: Audio driver abstraction layer.
tasks.notes: No Xbox audio API implementation.

tasks.name: Input state model
tasks.description: Keyboard, mouse and gamepad state model.
tasks.notes: Host input; not the Xbox input API.

tasks.name: Guest input delivery
tasks.description: Passing host input into guest input state.
tasks.notes: Guest-side GameInput not implemented.

tasks.name: Boot status reporting
tasks.description: Honest boot status reporting for launches.

tasks.name: Synthetic boot path
tasks.description: Synthetic PE boot reaching an entry point and an HLE callback.
tasks.notes: Synthetic images only.

tasks.name: Retail title boot
